# A2-only pipeline finish estimate

Checked: 2026-09-08T01:01:04.406623-07:00. All times Pacific.
Deadline: Wednesday, September 9, 11 AM; approximately 34 hours remain.

| Repository | Observed source recovery | Remaining source pass, conditional | Source + README repair + fresh B2, conditional |
|---|---|---|---|
| mir_eval | 6/13 eligible A2 failures recovered natively | About 15–60 minutes | Tuesday approximately 3–7 AM |
| Thumbnailator | 4/22 eligible A2 failures recovered natively | About 30–120 minutes | Tuesday approximately 4–10 AM |
| tslearn | Waiting for three A2 provider failures to clear | About 1–3 hours after A2 completes, assuming a cohort near the current 30 runtime failures | About 4–14 hours after A2 completes; no reliable clock-time estimate yet |

These are planning scenarios for the A2 treatment path, not forecasts that all
baselines or semantic reviews will finish in those windows. They assume normal
provider responses and roughly one to three document rounds on average. Five
rounds on many APIs, repeated 504s, downstream validation failures or source
provider retries after B2 can exceed these windows.

Measured support: mir_eval's first six completed source cases took roughly
31–155 seconds each for diagnosis plus snippet proposals; one required two code
rounds. Thumbnailator's first four completed cases took roughly 39–50 seconds,
but the fifth is much slower, so completed-case timing alone is optimistic.
Recorded A2 non-provider API attempts averaged approximately 18.5 seconds for
mir_eval, 23 seconds for Thumbnailator and 14.3 seconds for tslearn; a similarly
paced full fresh evaluation would take approximately 46, 57 and 56 minutes,
respectively, before additional provider waits. These are historical timing
observations, not proof that a rewritten README will reproduce that throughput.

The document loop has not started in v2. A full accepted document round can
include four model calls: deep dive, diagnosis, rewrite and fresh API test.
The above windows budget roughly 20–60 seconds per call, variable round counts
and extra headroom. tslearn's document loop can consider all non-pass A2 results,
including the current 27 infrastructure failures, while source recovery excludes
those infrastructure outcomes; its document cohort may therefore be near 57,
not merely the source cohort near 30. The final A2 result determines both cohorts.

Full-comparison blocker at inspection: 82 unresolved baseline provider outcomes:
mir_eval A1 29; Thumbnailator A1 4; tslearn A1 46 and A2 3. Repeated errors are
about 600-second Gemini 504 DEADLINE_EXCEEDED responses. A1 no longer blocks
A2 repair, but it is still required for the complete original-versus-generated
comparison. Unlimited provider resumption means there is no finite worst-case
finish time. Do not treat one retry sweep as guaranteed completion.

All three new controllers were alive. Thumbnailator A1 had finished its latest
invocation with four provider failures and was waiting for its scheduled retry;
it was not a missing or stuck worker. No jobs were started or changed for this
estimate. Native recovery counts remain separate from independently validated
correctness.

The existing observer is scheduled to freeze the available evidence at or after
Wednesday 10:45 AM for the 11 AM report. That package may be partial if provider
failures persist. MDAnalysis, Sedona and an RDPro rerun are excluded from this ETA.
